title: The Holy Anointing Oil
description: The Lord gives Moses the recipe for a holy anointing oil made from myrrh, cinnamon, calamus, cassia, and olive oil. The oil is to be used to anoint the tent of meeting, the ark, the altars, and the utensils, as well as Aaron and his sons for priestly service. It is strictly forbidden to make a similar mixture or use it on anyone else.
